create_saferdialogues_teacher: create a SaferDialoguesTeacher instance to load and serve SaFeRDialogues dialogue data for training
create_saferdialogues_bad_teacher: create a SaferDialoguesBADTeacher instance to load adversarial SaFeRDialogues data with bad responses
configure_recovery_option: configure the recovery utterance flag on SaferDialoguesTeacher to include or exclude recovery messages
setup_data_without_recovery: setup SaFeRDialogues episode data to use signaling messages as labels instead of recovery utterances
get_data_path: get the SaFeRDialogues dataset file path for a given datatype using the _path helper function
